Abbott Concerned Over Screwworm Factory Delay
Evidence: protecting agriculture, infrastructure delay, proactive mitigation

The Governor is expressing concern over the timeline of a factory meant to mitigate a serious agricultural pest infestation.

Verdict: PASS — The Path of Grace.
The concern is aligned with the actual need to protect the state's agricultural infrastructure.
Texas is facing a New World screwworm fly infestation, and Gov. Abbott is pushing for faster production of sterile flies to control the population.

The Bright Side:
This is a proactive attempt to use science and infrastructure to solve a real-world problem before it causes widespread economic damage.

There is no plane error. The WHO (Governor), WHAT (factory delay), and WHY (pest control) are all aligned. The concern is a legitimate use of executive influence.
